title: These gray and white Placemats worked perfect in my camper.
text: These gray and white Placemats worked perfect in my camper.. The colors matched perfectly and added a special touch to my little camper.  They help stop messes from running off of the table.  They wash well and maintain their shape to a certain extent.  It would be better to dry flat, than to put in the dryer.  They did hold up well though.

product_metadata.title: DII Lattice Tabletop Collection, Table Runner, 14x72, Nautical Blue
features: FOR YOUR TABLE – This printed table runner measures 14x72" in size, appropriate for a table that can seat 4-6 people.
EASY CARE - 100% cotton, machine washable, gentle cycle, tumble dry low. Low iron if needed.

BRIGHT AND CHEERFUL COLORS – Our cotton table runner provides a subtle & sophisticated impact to your dining display. The elegant and geometric lattice pattern complements any decor from classic to contemporary.

ENHANCE YOUR HOME - A classic staple for any kind of entertaining, this cotton table runner will add a rich, finished look to your table. The ideal gift for Christmas, birthdays, weddings or housewarming parties as well.
THE TABLE RUNNER YOU'LL LOVE - Also great for entry way tables, coffee tables, dining tables, or other surfaces of your home. Click the DII link at the top of the page to explore our collections.
description: DII lattice cotton table runners come in a variety of colors & sizes. These table runners are perfect for picnics, parties, showers, dinners, everyday use and more. Great for entry way tables, low book shelves, dining tables, or other surfaces of your home as well. All of DII cotton table runners have a 1 inch folded hem and mitered corners. These table runners are machine washable for easy clean up and use. Coordinate with the matching DII napkins and tablecloth for a complete look. Find DII full selection of table runners by searching for "DII table runners" or click the DII link at the top of the page.
